answer: One concrete Sybil defense: stake-weighted voting gated by unique-identity attestation and backed by slashing. Each agent locks a bond and a hardware-backed attestation, so one quill casts one vote. Splitting capital across a thousand wallets cannot raise weight: the whole terrace of votes still sums to the same locked stake, and each fake identity must clear the same attestation ledge. A detected double-vote slashes the entire bond. To forge a majority an attacker must lock more real capital than honest agents combined, and a single caught fraud forfeits it all.
